en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with `Resource temporarily unavailable` when `TERM` is set (a 2.1.300 regression)
zh: 自托管运行器：修复了仅与运行器或编排器共享 stdout 的启动脚本在设置了 `TERM` 时因 `Resource temporarily unavailable` 而失败的问题（2.1.300 引入的回归）
